chemistry-killer-08.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-08.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-08.material: Nkpuru nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, oke formula 40) 20 % (pasent oke) bụ 1.2 g/mL. A chọrọ ịkwụsị ngwọta a na mmiri iji mepụta 600 mL nke ngwọta mmiri NaOH 0.5 M. Kedu olu (mL) nke ngwọta NaOH 20 % achọrọ? (Oke atọm H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x bụ pasent oke, d bụ nkpuru ngwọta g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Nkpuru nke ngwọta mmiri sodium hydroxide ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, oke formula 40) 20 % (pasent oke) bụ 1.2 g/mL. A chọrọ ịkwụsị ngwọta a na mmiri iji mepụta 600 mL nke ngwọta mmiri NaOH 0.5 M. Kedu olu (mL) nke ngwọta NaOH 20 % achọrọ? (Oke atọm H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x bụ pasent oke, d bụ nkpuru ngwọta g/mL)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Molarity nke NaOH 20 % $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (n'ime 1 L = 1200 g ngwọta, NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Nzọụkwụ 2: Mole solute nke ngwọta a chọrọ ime = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Nzọụkwụ 3: Mole solute na-adịgide n'ịkwụsị: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Nyocha: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = 60 g ngwọta, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Azịza: 50 mL (d). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 60 mL leghaara nkpuru anya ma tụọ M = 5.0, 72 mL mụbara 60 g site na nkpuru, 5.0 mL bụ njehie nke ebe decimal)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
